title: Oxaze
description: Attempts to add more blocks in the way of parallel universe inspired exploration whilst aiming to remain a relatively vanilla-styled mod.
body:
Attempts to add more blocks in the way of parallel universe inspired exploration whilst remaining a relatively vanialla-styled mod.

In this mod, you will explore a few new dimensions, more post-netherite item progression and a few other things.

Currently there are only 2 dimensions, those being:
Tundra Barrens
Glass desert

Hope u enjoy! :>
Yet another mod out there that adds new dimensions and post game progression!

This project is currently a wip and may update over time, currently functions on the 1.21.4 version of the game.

 

*This mod was made with MCreator. If you want to make a mod its perfect for starters wanting to make mods.
